name: chart-composed-01
title: chart-composed-01
description: Monthly operating performance · Jan–Jun 2026. Revenue exceeded the June target by $96k.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Revenue against target” with the muted eyebrow “Monthly operating performance · Jan–Jun 2026”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Combine Jan–Jun Revenue ($k) bars at 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, 368 with a Target ($k) monotone line at 140, 178, 190, 210, 245, 272. Use distinct colors, 70% opacity rounded bars up to 38px wide, a 3px line with 3px dots, and a legend. Show $368k and note revenue exceeded the June target by $96k.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use Jan–Jun month labels, a numeric vertical axis, subtle horizontal grid lines, and muted axis labels and baselines.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
